reviews.title: Great Cooling & Stunning RGB Lightin
reviews.comment: The upHere 120mm RGB Case Fans are great for anyone looking to upgrade their PC’s cooling while adding vibrant lighting effects! These fans deliver high airflow, keeping my system cool even during intense gaming sessions. One of the standout features is how quiet they are—despite the strong airflow, they run smoothly and silently, making them perfect for a distraction-free setup. The RGB lighting is bright and well-diffused, creating a stunning visual effect that enhances my build’s aesthetics. Installation was quick and hassle-free, and the build quality feels solid for the price. If you're looking for affordable, efficient, and stylish case fans, this 3-pack is a fantastic choice Highly recommended for gamers and PC enthusiasts 💻✨
reviews.author: Drew

reviews.title: Amazing fans for the price!
reviews.comment: To be honest, I watched a youtube video comparing these fans to other more expensive options. Due to that, I figured I would take a chance on upHere's RGB fans. Let me just say that these fans just blew me away. For $20 you get 3 RGB fans! They come with their own controller and remote which may be a problem but for me (a college student) I had zero problems with these! You can connect like 10 fans up to 1 controller? Anyway enough hyping up let's talk about the pros and cons. Pros: - For $20 they look amazing, not corsair level but pretty darn close. - They have arrows on them showing which direction to point the fan (Intake/outtake) - They sync together - Wires are long enough to get to the controller (For my case) - There is a shload of modes, like Jesus there is a lot. - Included noise reduction pads - Build quality is nice Cons: - Unfortunately trying to hide the fan cables can be a challenge, I thought there would be some holes around the edges of the fans so that you could route cables to make them look nicer. However, there isn't so trying to hide the cables is a little difficult but you can do it. - Unfortunately, there is no software to control these fans but for $20 I really could care less. - The fans are somewhat louder than what you might expect. I'm sure you can lower the fan speeds someway but the noise isn't terrible. - There is no (included) way to attach the fan controller to your case, so I just used command strips (Velcro ones) and it works great. - The screws can be a little difficult to screw in. - A problem I started to have is that sometimes the fans would flash green for a second. Really it is just an aesthetic issue, so they are still amazing fans! Overall, these are some amazing fans and for $20 they are a steal! I would totally order these again! Update: So I had a small problem with my fans. However, once I got in contact with their customer support through amazon they helped out and did what they could to solve my problem. So for that, I'm thankful! Overall, a great company and the fans work out great! For that, I will leave my 5-star rating.
reviews.author: AJ

reviews.title: Last a long time, Might need and extender/splitter
reviews.comment: These fans are amazing. I've has them in my pc for about 2 years, and they still run quietly and smoothly, and the LED's are still bright and illuminate my PC very well. I wish you could do custom colors, but besides that the colors given are nice and simple and can match many different colorways. For the placement in my computer, I did have to use a cable extension, so I would recommend buying and extender or a splitter if you are making a budget build. Overall a great product!
reviews.author: Preslee J

reviews.title: Very Nice Quality fans for the price!
reviews.comment: The fan was very Nice and very quiet! I had some difficulty with the remote you need to hit auto or hold it down to change the colors on it. it took me a while to figure it out. The colors are very nice and I am gonna buy another set later when I can for my pc, but the airflow is amazing and super quiet like I said. Good item for the price definitely recommend these fans for a good look and airflow if you are looking for a cheaper set of fans these are the right choice.
reviews.author: Branndon

reviews.title: PC Tech of 30 years - no aRGB pins on your board? Problem Solved & More!
reviews.comment: I have bought UpHere fans in the past and have been very pleased. Yet buying this fan kit, with three fans, controller and remote, had me a bit worried. Maybe the translation to English on the Amazon product page was a bit unclear.. like what exactly can this kit do or NOT do. Foremost, the other reviews suggesting they could have better light dissipation is true. But at THIS price point the value outweighs everything. I did NOT use the spare mainboard aRGB wire on the control hub and just plugged the power cable to the PSU sata power. The moment the computer turns on, I have full control of fan speed and color themes. Then I bought an ID-Cooling CPU tower, but the ASRock 10th gen mainboard aRGB software was not working on the CPU fan. On the hub controller for THIS kit I just bought, there are two generic ports for regular aRGB. I plugged the CPU fan into that.. and wallah.. all 4 fans obey the remote. This means I can also add one more NON-Proprietary aRGB fan to the hub. Finally, as long as I locate more  UpHere aRGB fans that FIT THE PROPRIETARY hub, I can add another 5 aRGB fans in addition to all the I just stated above. I'm impressed!
